translations.web: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
translations.bsb: A man’s own folly subverts his way, yet his heart rages against the LORD.
translations.kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
